content:
Nina: Heads-up: new manager (infra) starts next Tues. Need a lightweight manager+HR checklist and a short 1-week agenda thats not calendar heavy. Also who to contact for office access and KMS?

Ralph: Quick checklist: 
- Preboard (Day -3 to 0): laptop procured, Okta invite, GitHub/Gsuite invite, desk booking if onsite
- Day 1 AM: People Ops welcome (payroll + benefits) (20m)
- Day 1 mid: Manager 30m welcome + 30/60 expectation sketch
- Day 1 afternoon: IT & access sweep (VPN, KMS request placeholder)
- Day 2: Buddy pairing for repo + run CI smoke test
- Day 3: Security intro + infra overview (45m)
- End week: 30m sync on blockers and 60-day priorities

Ralph: For contacts: office desk/keys -> Facilities (cc Marco), KMS/VPN -> Tess (security), repo access -> eng-admin (me).

Tess: For any KMS access we need a signed AUP and manager approval. I can pre-stage a least-privileged role for dev work once manager approves. Also schedule a 30m security primer in week 1.

Marco: Facilities note: if theyre hybrid, tell me which days onsite and Ill reserve a flex desk + parking. For local SIMs, submit procurement form.

Nina: Can you drop a short "first-week agenda" I can paste into the offer email? Prefer short bullet list.

Ralph: Sure, copy/paste below:
Mon
- 09:30 People Ops welcome & forms (20m)
- 10:15 Manager intro + role context (30m)
- 13:00 Team lunch (30m)
- 15:00 IT access sweep (VPN, Okta) (30m)
Tue
- 09:30 Buddy pair: dev env + run CI (2h)
- 14:00 Product/PM intro (30m)
Wed
- 10:00 Security primer (Tess) (30-45m)
Thu
- Focus: first small task / PR + 1:1s
Fri
- 11:00 Week 1 readout with manager (30m)

Tess: Suggested 30/60/90 bullets to share:
- 30 days: dev env stable, first minor change merged, 1:1 cadence established
- 60 days: leading a small infra feature, owning runbook improvements
- 90 days: delivering an independent initiative and mentoring others

HR Bot: New hire packet created: "Infra Manager - start 2026-04-13". Tasks assigned: Nina (manager), Ralph (eng-admin), Tess (security), Marco (facilities). Preboard email scheduled. Link: https://hr.redwood.internal/onboard/INF-912

Nina: Thanks! Ill add the hire to this thread tomorrow and confirm onsite days. Ralph please pre-stage a tiny first-PR task (README + make test).

Ralph: Will do. Ill add the task and buddy calendar event.

Tess: Ill prep the security invite after manager approval.

Marco: Facilities standing by for desk booking.

Nina: Great, closing loopIll send invites tonight.
